reason: The description accurately captures the core logic for both absolute and relative includes, with minor omissions such as the fallback to '/' for absolute roots. However, it misleadingly suggests that errors are thrown for absolute includes when not found and no includer, while the implementation only throws for relative includes.
missing_functionality: No mention of the fallback to '/' when options.root is not provided for absolute paths in the single-root case
incorrect_or_misleading_points: The description implies that errors may be thrown for absolute paths when the include is not found and no custom includer is provided, but the implementation never throws for absolute paths; it silently returns undefined.
